title: Xdrip+ with Blucon Nightrider on Full-Android-Smartwatch (No.1 D6, Android 5.1): Bluetooth issue
symptom: After installing xDrip+ on a smartwatch with Android 5.1 (No.1 D6), connecting to the Blucon Nightrider initially gave 'Invalid PIN' errors. Once connected, when the Nightrider leaves Bluetooth range, xDrip+ often fails to reconnect, even after 30 minutes, toggling Bluetooth, or restarting the collector. Rebooting the watch or switching the Blucon off/on usually restores connection. On a tablet with Android 7.0, reconnection happens within 1-3 minutes without action.
cause: The issue appears to be specific to the No.1 D6 smartwatch, as xDrip+ works fine on other devices (Ourtime X01 Air, Finow Q1 Pro, Finow M9, Microwear H5). The thread does not identify a definitive root cause beyond device-specific Bluetooth behavior.
fix: No fix was found for the No.1 D6; the issue was closed as it was deemed specific to that device. Users with similar issues on other Android 5.1 smartwatches (e.g., Ourtime X01S) reported partial success by pairing via system Bluetooth first, but reconnection remained unreliable.
evidence_quote: I close this issue, as xDrip+ is working fine on Ourtime X01 Air, Finow Q1 Pro, Finow M9 and Microwear H5. So it seems to be a problem just with the No.1 D6, which needn't be analyzed any further.
